name: acme/tfcenv
description: Register Terraform Cloud workspace variables from the CLI

phpx: test -n "$PHP_HOME"  || { echo 'PHP_HOME is unset. Run inside: nix develop'  >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.compile: test -n "$PHPX_HOME" || { echo 'PHPX_HOME is unset. Run inside: nix develop' >&2; exit 1; }; php vendor/bin/tpc.php project.yml -o tfcenv --no-progress
doctor: printf "tpc       : %s\n" "$(test -f vendor/bin/tpc.php && echo vendor/bin/tpc.php || echo '<not installed>')"

scripts-descriptions.tfcenv: Run the CLI through the PHP interpreter, without an AOT build
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite through the PHP interpreter
scripts-descriptions.phpx: Build libphpx, the runtime the generated C++ links against
scripts-descriptions.compile: AOT compile src/ into a native ./tfcenv binary
scripts-descriptions.clean: Remove the build and dist directories and the binary
scripts-descriptions.doctor: Show what the toolchain resolved to
scripts-descriptions.bundle: Package ./tfcenv with its libraries so it runs without Nix (macOS)
scripts-descriptions.bundle-linux: Build and package the Linux artifact inside Docker
scripts-descriptions.verify-linux: Run the Linux artifact on a plain Ubuntu container, no Nix
